coaching.headline: Big objectives. Broken base.
coaching.team: We secured major buffs and produced a dominant fight, but the late objective sequence ended with heavy deaths before the base losses piled up. Winning a neutral does not make the whole exchange good; that buff was no condom for the base.

focus.title: Call the exit before the take
focus.action: Before the next major objective, agree where the team retreats and who handles the base defense.

perPlayer.9ec9a569-ce18-4a46-8f58-98d28b3b75d1: Crunch kept the farm moving, then spent too much time dead to make that gold useful. Keep the income; review the late death for an earlier exit and take that correction into the next game. A full wallet does fuck-all from the death screen.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Narbash delivered the healing, but the repeated deaths need scrutiny, not a support excuse. Keep that output. Review which deaths actually protected teammates and which could have been avoided, then fix the avoidable ones. Being the healer is not a license to donate his ass.
perPlayer.4adab30d-c60a-4995-a659-c46fe0768ed2: Serath supplied the damage and objective pressure this team needed. Keep it, but fix the thin ward placement: put vision on a safe approach before the next neutral setup. Strong damage does not make information optional.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Howitzer contributed damage and still finished with the team's worst death count. Keep the damage; review those deaths for a recurring decision and change it if one emerges. This is the priority before another build tweak. A fashionable build is not a fucking respawn discount.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eden's farm and survival both fell short. Make reliable income the recovery priority: prioritize reachable waves between fights and review the midgame death for a safer route. Recovery needs income that does not come with another death attached.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~1.5s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

ourKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
ourKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

ourKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
ourKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
ourKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

ourKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
ourKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
ourKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
ourKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down
